bodies.heading: Radar and C4I sustainment, inside the Kingdom
bodies.lede: 3Lines maintains radar systems to 4th-line level inside Saudi Arabia, including the AN/TPS-78 for the Royal Saudi Air Force. We hold a Maintenance Level Agreement (MLA) with Northrop Grumman, the radar’s manufacturer, enabling in-country sustainment that raises operational readiness and localizes advanced technical capability. Our teams cover radar, surveillance, C4I and secure tactical communications end to end — diagnostics, repair, calibration and return to service.
